fairUse.rationale: Small publisher-authored illustrated rulebook cover identifies the game discussed in this starting-rule article; it is used for editorial reference with no more artwork than needed for identification.
fairUse.provenance: Page 1 of the cited publisher-authored rulebook, English Rule of Exploration front with original game art. The image is labeled as a rulebook cover rather than a retail box. Reduced to 279 × 360 pixels for display.

firstPlayerRule: The rules suggest that the player who looks most like a pirate starts. If players cannot agree who makes the most convincing pirate, the oldest player starts.
officialTieBreak: If players cannot agree who looks most like a pirate, the oldest player starts.
clarifications: Players may make pirate faces and growl “arrrr matey” to help make the choice.
Play proceeds clockwise from the first player.
